_what: What a prepositional phrase adds to its clause (plan 2.13): six families, each with its types. A rule or a judge names the most specific level it is sure of; where it knows the family but not the type, it names the family, which is less wrong than a guess and more useful than none. In RDF each type is a sub-property of its family. Status: ruled by Doug, 2026-10-17, from his marks on docs/review/prep-phrases-2026-10-17.html and four decisions that day; the definitions are drafts until they enter a vocabulary release.
_rulings: Two levels, families over types (Doug, 2026-10-17: 'Families + types').

'in the name of' is authority: by whose authority an act is done (Doug, 1 Samuel 17:45: 'in the name is a common phrase and I view it as authority - you can make this my call which I will stand behind').
Authority is split from dominion: acting by someone's authority is a footing for an act (grounds); ruling over someone is a relation between persons (toward someone). Doug, 2026-10-17: 'Split'.
Isaiah 53:5 'upon him' is target, not recipient: nothing is handed over, said or shown to him; it falls on him (Doug, 2026-10-17: 'Target').
Sphere is allowed, always as a reading, never by rule, and defined only grammatically, never as union (Doug, 2026-10-17: 'Allowed, always a reading').
John 1:1 πρὸς τὸν θεόν is accompaniment or presence, not direction: with a verb of being and a person, there is no movement (Doug: 'With God being a being, direction does not fit').
New names from Doug's marks: basis (Proverbs 3:5), target (Acts 1:8), circumstance (Revelation 1:9 'in the tribulation'), sphere (Revelation 1:9 'in Jesus').

basis is renamed rests_on: the structure vocabulary's basis is the reason given for a command, a different meaning, and two meanings cannot share an address (Doug, 2026-10-17: 'rename basis to rests_on').

purpose and means are each ONE term at both levels, the clause link and the prepositional type, so one query finds the aim, or the means, between clauses and inside a clause (Doug, 2026-10-17: 'share purpose like means').

composed_of is added for what a thing is made of: Matthew 3:4 'a garment of camel's hair' could be named only at the family level, since no type said material (Doug, 2026-10-18: 'composed_of would be more intuitive if it exists'; approved as P-2026-10-18-9).

according_to is added under grounds for the standard something is in keeping with: the 210 κατά 'according to' phrases had been scattered over eight answers, and Ephesians 1:5 and 1:7 came back 'the footing is clear but the type is' not (Doug, 2026-10-18: 'name it according_to under grounds'; approved as P-2026-10-18-10).

setting.means: where, when, or in what conditions the action takes place

types.place: where something is or happens (in the house, on the mountain, among the people)
types.presence: before someone, in a person's presence (stood before the LORD)
types.time: when, or for how long (in the morning, after three days)
types.circumstance: the situation or condition in which something happens (in the tribulation, in distress)
types.sphere: the domain within which something is said to be or be true (in Christ, in the Spirit); always a reading, never by rule, defined only grammatically

types.direction: toward or into a place, as the goal of a movement (went to Egypt)
types.source: from, out of: where something comes from or is separated from (from Judah)
types.extent: as far as, up to: a limit in space or amount (as far as Dan)

types.recipient: the one to whom something is handed over, said or shown (said to him, gave to them)
types.beneficiary: for whose sake or good something is done (for you)
types.target: the one upon whom something comes or falls, with nothing handed over (the Spirit comes upon you; the punishment was upon him)
types.opposition: against: a hostile target (fought against Israel)
types.dominion: over: rule or charge over someone (king over Israel)

types.cause: because of what (because of their sin)
types.purpose: the aim of the act (for an offering)
types.rests_on: what something rests or relies on, not physically (lean not on your own understanding; trust in)
types.authority: by whose authority an act is done (in the name of the LORD)
types.according_to: the standard or norm something is in keeping with (according to the law, according to His will, according to their deeds)

how.means: how the act is done, by what or with whom

types.manner: how it is done (with all your heart, in righteousness)
types.means: the thing used, or the means by which it is done (with a sword, through him)
types.agent: by whom, with a passive verb (spoken by the prophet)
types.accompaniment: together with someone (went with him; the Word was with God)

between_things.means: how one thing relates to another, mostly on a noun

types.possession: belonging to (the field belonging to Boaz)
types.partitive: some of, one of (one of the mountains)
types.comparison: like, as, than (like a lion, better than)
types.composed_of: what something is made of (a garment of camel's hair; an altar of earth)
